text.description_html:
Acorn RT8BD, Half Round Rough Black Iron Knobset

This fanciful knob is great for homes where the beauty of the old world is appreciated. It is made out of rough black iron so that the texture is not unlike that of naturally weathered iron. This grants the knob and rose set a more natural appearance that alludes to an agedness; but although the outside may look antique, the inner workings of this finely crafted knobset is all new. It is available in dummy, passage, and privacy functions for doors with 2-3/8 inch or 2-3/4 inch backsets that are 1-3/8 inches to 1-3/4 inches thick.

Features of the Half Round Rough Black Iron Knob:

  • Fits all standard pre-drilled doors: 2-1/8" crossbores, 1" edgebores
  • Recommended for interior use. These latch sets are not designed for heavy doors, but may be extended for thicker doors.

Specifications for the Rough Black Iron Half Round Knob:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" to 1-3/4"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Front: 1" x 2-1/4"

When Selecting a Function:

  • Half Dummy: A stationary knob for use as a pull or to match trim on one side of door. Includes 1 knob, 1 rose, and mounting screws.
  • Passage Set (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latch operates from either side of door. Complete set - 2 knobs, 2 roses, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.
  • Privacy Set (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need locking. Latch operates from either side. Push button on interior knob engages privacy; emergency release hole is on exterior knob. Complete set - 2 knobs, 2 roses, privacy button, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.

Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!
